description: Get the direct media links behind a social-media post or page (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Weibo, Douyin and 1000+ other sites; short links work): video / image / audio URLs plus caption and author. op "post" ($0.004) reads one post; "playlist" ($0.02 a page) lists a profile, channel, playlist or topic, with next_cursor for the next page; "subtitles" ($0.004) returns YouTube / Bilibili subtitles; "youtube_download" ($0.012) returns a temporary download link (up to 1080p, valid about an hour). Only process media the user has the right to use. Failed calls are not billed.

cursor.description: playlist only: the next_cursor from the previous page.

url.description: The post, profile, channel or video page URL.

name: extract_media
